decisions.reason: Because B has survived four years without a clear shortfall relative to aspirations and slack still allows carrying this two-component unit, management keeps it while monitoring the category after the earlier A withdrawal.

Automatic airless spray guns are central to the firm's application technology and now have a longer performance record that appears to meet aspirations, so the firm keeps C with a low drop probability.
Manual airless spray guns fit the established customer base and existing manufacturing, and with no evidence of below-aspiration results, slack favors keeping D.
The air-assisted airless line extends core spray technology across several models, and after four years without a clear performance shortfall management keeps E.
The data logger remains less aligned with core mechanical capabilities, so its drop probability is higher, but slack and the absence of a clear shortfall still lead the firm to keep F for now.
